programme.title: Katanya S1 E7
programme.desc: We are born, grew up, evolved in a country that upholds the rules and laws designed by the government. Even for marriage matters, we have regulations that must be obeyed by the community; otherwise the citizens would be subject to legal sanctions, and the one which is no less bad: social sanctions. It is said that interfaith marriages in Indonesia are illegal. Is it true that the belief in claiming it illegal is still relevant to be upheld today?

programme.title: Katanya S1 E7
programme.desc: Kita lahir, bertumbuh, berevolusi di sebuah negara yang menjunjung tinggi peraturan dan undang - undang hasil rancangan pemerintah. Hingga urusan pernikahan pun memiliki pasal - pasal yang wajib ditaati oleh masyarakat, kalau tidak akan dikenakan sanksi hukum dan tidak kalah buruk; sanksi sosial. Katanya menikah beda agama di Indonesia dinyatakan ilegal, apakah kepercayaan pada pernyataan tersebut masih relevan untuk dianut hingga sekarang?

programme.desc: Journey of Hary Tanoesoedibjo and Liliana Tanoesoedibjo from early struggle & affection, to unite in marriage. Hary, a brave and hardworking man, who falls in love with Liliana, a gentle and multitalented girl, in a friends birthday party. That night was the beginning of their love story which continued to life story of their marriage with trials and struggles.

programme.title: Melody Of Love 2022
programme.desc: Perjalanan Hary Tanoesoedibjo dan Liliana Tanoesoedibjo dari masa perjuangan dan kasih sayang awal hingga bersatu dalam pernikahan. Hary, seorang pria pemberani dan pekerja keras, jatuh cinta pada Liliana, gadis lembut dan multitalenta, di sebuah pesta ulang tahun teman. Malam itu menjadi awal kisah cinta mereka yang kemudian berlanjut menjadi kisah kehidupan pernikahan dengan berbagai ujian dan perjuangan.

programme.title: Kisah Dua Ikan Sungai air Jernih
Kisah Dua Ikan Sungai air Jernih
programme.desc: Legenda yang berasal dari Sumatera Barat tentang Kisah Dua Ikan Sungai Air Jernih.

programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E5
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi is a television program that transforms uninhabitable homes of underprivileged families into safe and comfortable living spaces, while also presenting stories of struggle and new hope for the families.

programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E5
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi adalah program televisi yang mengubah rumah tidak layak huni milik keluarga kurang mampu menjadi tempat tinggal yang aman dan nyaman, sekaligus menghadirkan kisah perjuangan dan harapan baru bagi penghuninya.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E1
programme.desc: Hadid is an only child and heir to a wine-producing vineyard. At a party, Hadid meets Quinta, the plantation student who steals her heart. To find out the sincerity of the woman who loves him, Hadid hides his true identity by posing as an ordinary employee in his own vineyard office.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E1
programme.desc: Hadid adalah anak tunggal sekaligus pewaris kebun anggur yang memproduksi wine. Dalam suatu pesta, Hadid bertemu dengan Quinta, mahasiswi perkebunan yang mencuri hatinya. Untuk mengetahui ketulusan wanita yang mencintainya, Hadid menutupi identitas aslinya dengan menyamar sebagai karyawan biasa di kantor kebun anggurnya.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E2
programme.desc: Marco, a content producer and director who was transferred to Bali at the request of a client he refused to love. There, he met Andini, a sweet, cheerful and humble girl who worked with him as the host of digital content 'Sing Ken Ken'. With Andini, he feels he has found his true love. But it turns out that Andini already has a lover who is in a coma.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E2
programme.desc: Marco, seorang produser dan director content yang dimutasi ke Bali atas permintaan klien yang ia tolak cintanya. Disana, ia bertemu dengan Andini, gadis manis, ceria dan humble yang bekerja sama dengannya sebagai host konten digital 'Sing Ken Ken'. Dengan Andini, ia merasa menemukan cinta sejatinya. Namun ternyata Andini telah memiliki kekasih yang sedang koma.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E3
programme.desc: Nando, the son of a rich businessman who was diagnosed with cancer and has 2 years left to live. To forget his sadness, Nando works hard to become a restaurant manager. It was at this time, he met Emilia, his regular customer who has a hobby of stargazing. Emilia's presence had a good influence on Nando's health and life.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E3
programme.desc: Nando, seorang anak pengusaha kaya yang didiagnosa terkena kanker dan sisa hidupnya 2 tahun lagi. Untuk melupakan kesedihannya, Nando bekerja keras menjadi manajer restoran. Disaat inilah, dia bertemu Emilia, pelanggan tetapnya yang memiliki hobi meneropong bintang. Kehadiran Emilia memberikan pengaruh baik dalam kesehatan dan hidupnya Nando.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E4
programme.desc: Gania, a teacher at a surf course who is close friends with Barata, an art school student whose hobby is painting. Gania has a very beautiful new student named Agnes. Agnes' beauty makes all men fight for her, including Barata. Gania helps Barata approach Agnes wholeheartedly and is even willing to sacrifice her own feelings.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E4
programme.desc: Gania, seorang pengajar di surfing course yang bersahabat dekat dengan Barata, murid sekolah seni yang hobi melukis. Gania kedatangan murid baru yang sangat cantik bernama Agnes. Kecantikan Agnes membuat semua pria berebut memacarinya termasuk Barata. Gania membantu Barata mendekati Agnes dengan sepenuh hati bahkan rela mengorbankan perasaannya sendiri.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E5
programme.desc: The love story between Romeo and Julia must be hindered by the blessing of parents who have secret love in the past. They must be able to convince that their love and happiness is worth fighting for. Will their love survive?

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E5
programme.desc: Kisah cinta antara Romeo dan Julia harus terhalang restu orang tua yang memiliki rahasia cinta di masa lalu. Mereka harus bisa meyakinkan bahwa cinta dan kebahagiaan mereka layak diperjuangkan. Akahkah cinta mereka bertahan?

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E6
programme.desc: Hari and Lisa have been close friends since high school. Hari is always there for Lisa who is often fooled by men. Thanks to Hari, Lisa avoided being tricked by her new boyfriend, Roland, who dared to propose to her when in reality he was already married. In the end, Hari and Lisa have the same feelings, love each other.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E6
programme.desc: Hari dan Lisa berteman dekat sejak SMA. Hari selalu ada untuk Lisa yang seringkali dipermainkan oleh cowok. Berkat Hari, Lisa terhindar tipu muslihat dari cowok barunya, Roland yang berani melamarnya padahal kenyataannya telah beristri. Pada akhirnya, Hari dan Lisa memiliki perasaan yang sama, saling mencintai.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E2
programme.desc: The love dynamics of the three couples in South House boarding house are varied and full of drama. Elang and Elin always fight over small things. Jose and Lina rarely quarrel but they communicate to each other using harsh words. Then there are Dian and Opay, where Dian is suspicious about her partner, that she violates Opay's personal space.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E2
programme.desc: Dinamika percintaan tiga pasangan yang ada di Kostan South House bermacam-macam dan penuh drama. Elang dan Elin yang selalu bertengkar karena hal-hal kecil. Jose dan Lina yang jarang bertengkar tapi berkomunikasi menggunakan kata kasar. Lalu ada Dian dan Opay, dimana Dian menaruh rasa curiga hingga merusak ranah pribadi Opay.

programme.title: Entong
programme.desc: An Indonesian animation based on the famous soap opera on MNCTV, Si Entong, which aired in 2005.

programme.title: Entong
programme.desc: Animasi buatan Indonesia yang bercerita berdasarkan sinetron terkenal di MNCTV yaitu Si Entong yang ditayangkan pada tahun 2005 lalu.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E7
programme.desc: Soda and Gembira are two best friends who have a lot in common. Their friendship begins to fall apart when they meet Jennie, a beautiful woman who is also an environmental activist. They were both interested and tried to win Jennie's heart. However, Jennie did not choose one of the two and decided to remain friends.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E7
programme.desc: Soda dan Gembira adalah dua sahabat yang banyak memiliki kesamaan. Persahabatan mereka mulai berantakan saat bertemu dengan Jennie, wanita cantik yang juga aktivis lingkungan. Mereka sama-sama tertarik dan berusaha merebut hatinya Jennie. Namun, Jennie tak memilih satu dari keduanya dan memutuskan untuk tetap berteman saja.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E8
programme.desc: The love story between Adam and Vivi that started from the vcs service. Adam, a very established young entrepreneur. Meanwhile, Vivi is a woman who is forced to sell herself through the VCS service to pay for her mother's medical expenses. Adam, who at first just experimented, eventually became a regular customer and fell in love with Vivi.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E8
programme.desc: Kisah cinta antara Adam dan Vivi yang bermula dari layanan VCS. Adam adalah seorang pengusaha muda yang sangat mapan. Sementara itu, Vivi adalah seorang perempuan yang terpaksa menjual dirinya melalui layanan VCS demi membiayai pengobatan ibunya. Adam yang awalnya hanya coba-coba, lama-kelamaan menjadi pelanggan tetap dan akhirnya jatuh cinta kepada Vivi.

programme.title: 4 Sekawan Sebelum Dunia Terbalik
programme.desc: Idoy, Dadang, Aceng and Akum have been friends since childhood until now, peoples even call them the 4 Sahabat (buddies). When a problem emerge, Akum went to Jakarta leaving his three buddies behind. Idoy, who doesn't want his friendship to be destroyed, goes to Jakarta to apologized to Akum.

programme.title: 4 Sekawan Sebelum Dunia Terbalik
programme.desc: Idoy, Dadang, Aceng dan Akum berteman sejak kecil hingga sekarang, warga menyebut mereka 4 Sekawan. Sebuah masalah membuat mereka terpecah sehingga Akum pergi ke Jakarta meninggalkan Idoy, Aceng dan Dadang. Idoy yang tak ingin pertemanannya hancur berangkat ke Jakarta untuk meminta maaf kepada Akum.

programme.title: Bad Parenting
programme.desc: The story of a family that looks fine from the outside, but is in fact full of conflict. Even though Mom and Dad's relationship is still married, it's like a Broken Home family.

programme.title: Bad Parenting
programme.desc: Kisah sebuah keluarga yang tampak baik-baik saja dari luar, tetapi sebenarnya penuh konflik. Meskipun hubungan Ibu dan Ayah masih dalam ikatan pernikahan, keluarga ini seperti keluarga Broken Home.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E6
programme.desc: Jakarta is a town with thousands of Bakmi (Noodles) varieties with its own dynasties, and one of the most legendary Bakmis in town is Bakmie Acang. The uniqueness of Bakmie Acang is that they make their own noodles traditionally.

programme.desc: Jakarta adalah kota dengan ribuan ragam bakmi yang memiliki dinasti masing-masing, dan salah satu bakmi paling legendaris di kota ini adalah Bakmie Acang. Keunikan Bakmie Acang terletak pada proses pembuatan mienya sendiri yang masih dilakukan secara tradisional.

Kai gets involved and he is also chased by debt collectors.

programme.desc: Rafi, Yasmin, Dian, dan Opay heran melihat Kai membeli banyak barang mahal. Ternyata uang yang didapatkan Kai berasal dari uang slot Elang yang diputar dengan uang pinjol. programme.desc: A pharmacist is reborn into a magical world and uses his knowledge of medicine from his previous and current lives to become a great medical expert.

programme.title: Reborn To Master..., Ep 9
programme.desc: A legendary heroic king, Inglis, who had dedicated his life to his people, died with one regret: he had never had the chance to live as a warrior for himself. The goddess Alistia granted his wish by reincarnating him into the future as a noblewoman. However, she had declared him unfit to be a knight since childhood. Instead of giving up, Inglis saw it as a challenge and was determined to prove that becoming a knight is determined by ability on the battlefield, not by status or fate.

programme.title: Reborn To Master..., Ep 9
programme.desc: Seorang raja pahlawan legendaris, Inglis, yang telah mengabdikan hidupnya untuk rakyatnya, meninggal dengan satu penyesalan: belum sempat hidup sebagai pejuang untuk dirinya sendiri. Dewi Alistia mengabulkan keinginannya dengan mereinkarnasikannya ke masa depan sebagai seorang gadis bangsawan. Namun, ia dinyatakan tidak layak menjadi ksatria sejak kecil. Alih-alih menyerah, Inglis melihatnya sebagai tantangan dan bertekad membuktikan bahwa menjadi ksatria ditentukan oleh kemampuan di medan perang, bukan oleh status atau takdir.

programme.title: Reborn To Master..., Ep 10
programme.desc: A legendary heroic king, Inglis, who had dedicated his life to his people, died with one regret: he had never had the chance to live as a warrior for himself. The goddess Alistia granted his wish by reincarnating him into the future as a noblewoman. However, she had declared him unfit to be a knight since childhood. Instead of giving up, Inglis saw it as a challenge and was determined to prove that becoming a knight is determined by ability on the battlefield, not by status or fate.

programme.desc: Seorang pahlawan wanita terlibat dalam cinta segitiga dengan seorang pendekar pedang dan seorang prajurit saat bekerja sama untuk menaklukkan kekuatan jahat di dunia seni bela diri.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take it back.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan menemukan sebuah artefak langka, tapi mereka diracun oleh Nyonya Wu yang ingin mencurinya. Sebelum tewas, ketiganya meminta istri mereka berjanji guna melatih anak mereka untuk mengambilnya kembali.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, pemimpin Klan Petinju di Yunnan, membubarkan sebuah klan untuk menyelamatkan murid-muridnya sebelum pergi mengasingkan diri.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai and Fanny Fan join the dancing troupe of Kao Pao-shu. Linda and Kao's son Peter Chen, manager of the troupe, have misunderstandings and dislike each other.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai dan Fanny Fan bergabung dengan grup menari asuhan Kao Pao-shu. Linda dan putra Kao sang manajer grup, Peter Chen, mengalami salah paham dan akhirnya saling membenci.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching, a 17-year-old girl who marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when Li decides to go to the same school with her husband but attempting to hide their relationship.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching adalah gadis berumur 17 tahun yang menikahi gurunya yang berumur 35 tahun. Kelucuan terjadi ketika Li memutuskan untuk bersekolah di tempat sang suami bekerja dan berupaya menutupi hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Ode To Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly lighthearted 'Venoms' martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer (Kuo Chue) is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: Ode To Gallantry
programme.desc: Dalam petualangan seni bela diri 'Venoms' yang sangat menarik ini, seorang pengembara berulang kali dikira sebagai orang lain dan ia pun terseret ke dalam sejumlah pertarungan sengit.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. His pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: Seorang Pendeta Taois tidak senang ketika rekan Pendeta Buddha-nya pindah ke sebelah rumahnya. Mereka sering terlibat perselisihan dan duel, tetapi segera harus mengatasi masalah mereka ketika seorang vampir keluar dari peti matinya dan mendatangkan malapetaka di pedesaan.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: Marbles, seorang anak berusia 10 tahun, menyaksikan pembunuhan seorang wanita muda.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Kehidupan seorang sopir taksi Hong Kong berubah mengerikan setelah secara tidak sengaja menabrak seorang penyihir dengan taksinya. Dia memutuskan untuk meminta bantuan penyihir tersebut untuk membalikkan kutukan kepada musuh-musuhnya dengan mengorbankan nyawanya sendiri.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: A model (Joey Wong) gets raped by a photographer (Wilson Lam). Meanwhile, she falls out with her best friend (Carol Cheng) due to her boyfriend (Alex Man), who's a cop.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Seorang model (Joey Wong) diperkosa oleh seorang fotografer (Wilson Lam). Sementara itu, ia berselisih dengan sahabatnya (Carol Cheng) karena pacarnya (Alex Man), seorang polisi.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN

Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Hit The Road
programme.desc: One of the most appealing features of Japan's national road network is the various Michinoeki, literally way stations, that provide a place for motorists to rest, dine and shop. They offer information on the locality and restaurants with regional specialties, and often sell local crafts and delicacies for travelers to take home. A stop at one or more of these spots helps to make any road trip in Japan unforgettable.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Highlights
programme.desc: Sumo is without a doubt, one of the most Japanese of sports, boasting a history of more than 1500 years. We bring you daily highlights from the Grand Sumo Tournament held 6 times a year. See how powerful wrestlers with an average weight of more than 160 kilos clash in the sacred ring in a bid to claim the Emperor's Cup.

programme.title: Sumopedia
programme.desc: Sumopedia offers short videos to enrich your sumo experience. Learn about techniques, traditions, and famous wrestlers of the past. The rules may be simple, but the more you know, the more you see.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Japanese design is world famous, but that's not because of expensive, stylish or modern products. It's because excellent design exists within the tools and habits of everyday life. programme.title: Hit The Road
programme.desc: One of the most appealing features of Japan's national road network is the various Michinoeki, literally way stations, that provide a place for motorists to rest, dine and shop. They offer information on the locality and restaurants with regional specialties, and often sell local crafts and delicacies for travelers to take home. A stop at one or more of these spots helps to make any road trip in Japan unforgettable.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Highlights
programme.desc: Sumo is without a doubt, one of the most Japanese of sports, boasting a history of more than 1500 years. We bring you daily highlights from the Grand Sumo Tournament held 6 times a year. See how powerful wrestlers with an average weight of more than 160 kilos clash in the sacred ring in a bid to claim the Emperor's Cup.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. programme.desc: A cyborg, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten year old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

programme.title: Pernikahan Dini
programme.desc: Pasangan Duta dan Shinta, punya dua anak, Doddy dan Dini. Doddy sudah kuliah, Dini masih duduk di bangku SMA. Kesibukan Duta dan Shinta membuat keduanya kurang perhatian. Sampai di sini keluarga Duta masih baik-baik saja. Baru ketika Asniar datang dengan tuduhan yang memalukan: Doddy memperkosa Dyah, anak Asniar, semuanya jadi tidak keruan, Asniar meminta Doddy mempertanggungjawabkan perbuatannya. Semula Duta memang membela Doddy habis-habisan. Tapi ketika Asniar menyodorkan jaket Doddy sebagai buktinya, dia tidak bisa apa-apa. Selanjutnya, dia malah memarahi anaknya habis-habisan. Padahal, dia belum tahu kejadian yang sebenarnya. Doddy yang patah arang jadi sakit hati. Ujung-ujungnya dia pergi dari rumah.
